newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk government to announce early polls - minister.
newsitem.headline: Turk government to announce early polls - minister.

text.p: Turkish State Minister Abdullah Gul said Islamist Prime Minister Necmettin Erbakan and his secularist deputy, Tansu Ciller, would announce early elections at a news conference on Sunday.

"They will officially announce early elections. They may not give any date for them," Gul told Reuters at the prime minister's office ahead of a joint news conference by the two leaders of the crumbling 11-month-old coalition.

The news conference was set to start at 4 p.m. (1300 GMT) but talks were continuing at Erbakan's residence. Ciller's True Path Party (DYP) has been locked in bargaining with Erbakan's party over a possible date for early elections.
A DYP minister said on Saturday elections could be held as early as October to end the crisis in the coalition, sparked by military demands for a crackdown on Islamist activism.
Ciller has promised her party she would press Erbakan, modern Turkey's first Islamist leader, to let her lead the country to polls as caretaker head of government.
